pointer.excerpt: Comprehensive Playwright-based validation harness for three-way verification (devbob → SurrealDB → Dashboard UI). Implements multi-stage validation: Stage 1 - Execute activity on devbob via kubectl exec, Stage 2 - Query SurrealDB for ground truth, Stage 3 - Navigate to dashboard via Playwright, Stage 4 - Extract UI data, Stage 5 - Compare with variance assertions, Stage 6 - Capture screenshots, Stage 7 - Verify console clean. Returns pass/fail with detailed checks.
